import sqlite3

# Try to dump the entire database in a different way
conn = sqlite3.connect('main.db')
conn.execute('PRAGMA table_info(items)')
print('Table info:')
for row in conn.fetchall():
    print(row)

# Try to get data using different queries
print('\nAll data:')
cursor = conn.execute('SELECT * FROM items ORDER BY id')
for row in cursor:
    print(row)

# Check for any attached databases
print('\nAttached databases:')
cursor = conn.execute('PRAGMA database_list')
for row in cursor:
    print(row)

conn.close()
